notes: Golden Gate Park piece G2 (assigned box 1610,800,960,625): Spreckels Lake, the Polo Field's oval, JFK Dr, Marx Meadow Dr, Middle Dr West, South Dr. Box: bottom trimmed 15 px (h 625 -> 610, last row y 1409) to stay off the park's south boundary line (top of its ink y 1413 at x 2480-2570, y 1421 at x 1610); other sides unchanged, all inside the park. Every road is street; every enclosed piece of park land has its own open seed; no city block lies in the box. Judgment calls for the owner: (1) Polo Field oval, marked like the 1929 Stadium piece: the field (1742-2014, 1018-1184) is open; each ring band between two oval lines is street. From the field outward: ring A (its own closed ring; 7-10 px: x 1664-1670 at y 1150, y 1022-1029 at x 1920, x 2005-2014 at y 1100, y 1150-1158 at x 1880); ring W (18-25 px: x 1644-1661 at y 1150, y 998-1019 at x 1920, x 2017-2041 at y 1100, y 1162-1180 at x 1880) - the widest, it may be a bank, verge or stands rather than a way; ring B (7-9 px: x 1634-1640 at y 1150, y 988-996 at x 1920, x 2044-2051 at y 1100, y 1184-1192 at x 1880); ring C (5-8 px, outermost: x 1626-1630 at y 1150, y 979-986 at x 1920, x 2055-2061 at y 1100, y 1197-1204 at x 1880). Rings W, B and C open into the roads at the oval's north-west (1700-1760, 1000-1060) and south-west (1674-1717, 1240-1270), so they join the road network; ring A is closed and has its own street seed. The ink lines between two rings are left unseeded, so they are labelled street with no edge (islands at 1958,978; 1955,988; 1957,1009; 1731,1057; 1633,1132). (2) A circle inside ring A at the oval's west end (1690-1773, 1095-1193), cut off from the field by ring A, is open. (3) A crescent-shaped closed outline about 8 px wide inside ring A west of the circle (1671-1710, 1111-1196) is open, read as a structure (stands?); it may instead be a mark in the track. (4) Two narrow closed slivers at the ends of the line between rings B and C, 39 (1806-1872, 999-1023) and 68 (1822-1873, 1196-1223), 5-7 px wide, are open (traffic-island noses). Their ink joins the ring line and the hook-shaped island (1709-1803, 968-1046, open), so limits cut that ink where no line is printed across: (1805,1019-1027), (1875,998-1004), (1876,1193-1201). A fourth limit (1712,1233-1243) cuts the west ring line (C|B at x 1631-1633) from the outline of the land below the oval (1717-1812, 1237-1292), so that ring line stays street. (5) Two tiny closed outlines in the road junction west of the leaf-shaped island, a teardrop (1649-1659, 904-918) and a small oval (1655-1670, 919-932), are open as traffic islands. (6) Middle Dr West narrows to 8-12 px between the land below the oval and its south line (1720-1810, 1272-1305), with DR. WEST inside: read as the same road. (7) Lettering that touches both lines of a road (MIDDLE / DR / WEST at 2228-2296 and 2424-2569, y 1119-1137; DR. WEST at 1716-1812, y 1274-1305) or one line (SOUTH DR at 1620-1700 and 1756-1802; MARX MEADOW DR at 2314-2452, y 798-893) is cut from the land by strokes on the printed road lines, about 1 px toward the road, so the letters are street.
